title: Refuse a leaning LaneBrief at the dispatch door
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml verbs::drivers && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml brief_lint

truths: A brief carrying any of the 17 frozen verdict stems is refused at dispatch prepare with a typed refusal naming the phrase
A brief whose Question section enumerates candidate answers is refused, naming that section
A brief missing, adding, or misordering any of the four required sections is refused by the offending section's name
A dispatch carrying every frozen stem in --purpose and --expertise, with no --brief-file, prepares cleanly
The verdict-stem arm fires zero times over every checked-in packages/bee/prompts/*.md
The refusal text says leaning language is refused and never claims neutrality is enforced

artifacts.substantive: the two-arm guard plus its frozen 17-stem list, exposed as one pub(crate) entry point, no TODO stubs
red-first cases per arm, the scope test, the corpus test, and the section-arm cases

key_links: prepare.rs calls the shared guard on the brief bytes only, before building the payload
brief_lint.rs uses the scanners.rs primitives rather than new ones
prohibitions: The guard must never read --purpose, --expertise, the cell json, or any dispatch text other than the brief
The 17-phrase stem list must not be shortened to make a test pass
No refusal text or doc line may claim neutrality is enforced
No new dispatch kind, no new store, no new command namespace
The corpus test must not run the shape arm over packages/bee/prompts/*.md
